description: Evaluating a bare static map key of two traversal steps is an error
notes: The grammar allows any expression as a key and the prose only makes a bare identifier a literal name, so evaluating the key k.b would give "x". hashicorp/hcl rejects a bare traversal of more than one step when it evaluates a key, because it could be meant as a dotted name, and leaves such keys to static analysis (ObjectConsKeyExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
